**Get it on [Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/cardealersimulator/mods/54)**, or download `LukasMods-CDS-PartsManager-1.1.1.zip` below. Same file, sha256 `9c9864cdc70f19116e6d88054d06b7462a87a32cb7a7e497de15d04d5135120d`.

Needs the game's "Workshop Upgrades & Sprint Racing" update (October 2026) or later, and an **EXPERIMENTAL** build of UE4SS: [the one on Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/cardealersimulator/mods/53) is tested. The newer supply tiers come with the game's "New Materials & Manager Features" update. Updating from 1.0 or 1.1: copy the new folder over the old one; your `settings.txt` is kept. Install and full details: [Parts Manager guide](https://github.com/lukas-mods/Lukas-Mods/blob/main/guides/car-dealer-simulator/parts-manager.md).

> ⚠️ **Use at Your Own Risk.** Any mod can crash a game or damage a save, so back up your saves first (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\CarDealerSimulator\Saved\`). Parts Manager also spends real in-game money: while auto-stock is on, it keeps buying down to your Keep Balance Above floor.

## 1.1.1 - New Supply Tiers

- The Workshop tab now carries the newer supply tiers from the game's "New Materials & Manager Features" update. Each supply's Tier button switches between Basic and three more: Large, Range+ and Eco-friendly. Discs have Extra Durable in place of Large, and polisher pads have Extra and Eco. Add and Auto Supplies buy the tier you pick.
- The Tier button is wider and shows the tier name with an arrow, so the longer names fit and it's clear a click moves to the next tier.
